title: 2023 Topps Midnight Composite #342 Kellen Winslow San Diego Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Topps Midnight Composite trading card featuring Kellen Winslow, a player in the NFL. The card measures 3¾" x 2¾" and is an original release by Topps. It is part of the Topps Midnight Composite set for the 2023 season. The card number is 342 and it depicts Kellen Winslow in his San Diego team attire.
